claims: Pasting the creator's prompt into Claude Design high-fidelity mode yields a site with animations, interactive sliders, sideways scrolling and CTAs
Hand off to Claude Code lets you keep working on the site without worrying about Claude Design usage limits
how_to_steps: Go to claude.ai > Design > New prototype, click High fidelity, Create
Paste the long structured website prompt and send
Click Share > Hand off to Claude Code > Copy command
Paste the command into Claude Code and continue building there

gap.what: Liked set covers Claude Design uses and /clone-site, but not the built-in Share > 'Hand off to Claude Code' command (api.anthropic.com/v1/design/... fetch) as a way to offload iteration from Claude Design quota to Claude Code.

relevance.why: Useful quota tactic and a clean design-to-code handoff for landing pages; partially superseded by the /design skill in Claude Code.

implement_score.why: Minutes to try on the next marketing page: generate in Claude Design, hand off, iterate in Claude Code. The creator's prompt is comment-gated, so write your own sectioned brief.
